label: A present efficient cause of another's being is an actual CAUSE_2 of its being
paraphrase: OPEN analyst bridge, attribution deferred, the cross-vocabulary step without the per se link: if c is other than x and here and now c efficiently causes the being of x (EfficientlyCausesIn c x esse, DEF-EFFICIENT-CAUSING), then c is an actual cause of the being of x in the q.3 a.4 profile (ActualEsseCause, DEF 8163859b): both are in act as to being and CausesIn c x esse (CAUSE_2). Positive warrant: efficient causing is one mode of the mode-unspecified CausesIn; a present agent acts only as in act ('nihil agit nisi inquantum est actu'); an effect whose being is caused here and now has being. It relates the secunda via's here-and-now efficient causing to the q.3 a.4 cause of being, two distinct primitives; it is not the converse bridge (EsseCauseEfficiency.DistinctActualEsseCauseIsEfficient), which goes from a mode-unspecified to an efficient cause. No substantive objection identified.
